sources.title: AI Framework Diagnoses Leaf Disease, Tells Farmers What to Do Next
sources.snippet: The framework, developed by a team led by Lufu Qin from Guizhou University, uses a large language model to guide a series of specialized "skills," such as lesion measurement, literature retrieval, and pesticide-use planning. "Most systems stop at diagnosis," Qin said. "Farmers need more—they need to know *what* is wrong, *how severe* it is, and *what to do next*." AgriSkill-Agent ...
